erpLink.title: ERP link
erpLink.sub: This store's own link to its ERP company: its keys, what was synced, what is waiting, the balance and the switch to the new ERP contract.

link.title: The link
link.none: This store has no ERP link of its own yet. Type the store's own ERP keys below; the link opens the first time they are used.

keys.title: This store's ERP keys
keys.sub: The API key, the webhook secret and the signing secret of this store's own ERP company. They are kept locked in the vault for this store only; another store's keys never serve this one.

lastSummary.title: Last daily summary the ERP accepted

queues.title: Waiting
queues.heldSub: These orders were confirmed before the switch, and their old message never reached the ERP. Send each one again as a new (v6) order.
queues.sendWarn: The order goes to the ERP as a new (v6) order.

switch.title: Switch to the new ERP contract (v6)
switch.sub: On the ERP's switch date this store moves to the new contract: the ERP's list of moved old orders and the opening balance come in at the buying price, the month's days are filled from the ERP's cost of goods, customer payments and ad spend stop going to the ERP, and the old return switches turn off (never deleted). First a dry run, then the owner switches with his PIN.
switch.v6Done: This store speaks the new contract since {date}.
switch.dryRunWarn: Reads the ERP's switch list and shows what the switch would do. Nothing changes.
switch.stale: The last dry run is older than {h} hours. Run it again before switching.

report.backfill: Days filled from the ERP's cost of goods
report.legacy: Old return switches to turn off

action.resend: they go again as v6 orders
action.hold: they wait here for a person

switch.goWarn: Only the owner. This cannot be undone: the store moves to the new ERP contract for good.
switch.ownerOnly: Only the owner can switch a store.

blocker.NO_OWN_CONNECTION: This store's own ERP keys are not saved yet (above).
blocker.ERP_UNREACHABLE: The ERP could not be asked.
blocker.SHARED_COMPANY: The key's ERP company is linked to another store.
blocker.NOT_ANNOUNCED: The ERP has not given a switch date yet.
blocker.ERP_NOT_DONE: The ERP has not moved the old orders yet.
blocker.BEFORE_SWITCH_DATE: The switch date has not come yet.
blocker.TRANSFER_MISMATCH: The advances and unpaid amounts do not add up to the ERP's transfer.
blocker.OPENING_BALANCE_MISSING: The ERP has not given the opening balance.
blocker.BAD_AMOUNT: An amount is not exact in the store's money.
blocker.ORDER_UNKNOWN: An order on the ERP's list is not this store's.
blocker.LINES_MISMATCH: An order's lines do not add up to its amount.
blocker.SWITCH_DATE_CHANGED: The ERP's switch date is not the one kept here.
blocker.OPENING_DIFFERS: The opening balance kept here is not the ERP's. Start a new link to put it right.

newLink.title: Start a new link
newLink.sub: Ends this store's link to the ERP. Use it when the store is handed to a new owner (his own ERP keys come in, the old ones are switched off) or when the opening balance was wrong. The old link's history stays.
newLink.warn: Only the owner. The link ends now; nothing is deleted.

reasons.HANDOVER: The store goes to a new owner

newLink.done: The link has ended. The next one opens with the store's keys.

erpLink.note: Each store has its own ERP link: its own API key, webhook secret and signing secret, kept only in the vault for that store. A call with one store's key can never read or change another store.

err.OWNER_ONLY: Only the owner can do this.
err.SWITCH_BLOCKED: Something stops the switch. Run the dry run again to see what.
err.CONFIRM_DATE: The date is not the ERP's switch date.
err.DRY_RUN_STALE: The ERP's list changed after the dry run. Run it again.
err.NOT_AVAILABLE: This cannot be done from here.
err.ERP_MODEL: The store does not speak the new ERP contract yet.

demo.title: Acceptance test against the demo ERP
demo.sub: Every night and before every release the shop checks the ERP contract against the demo ERP. It needs the demo shop's key, typed once here; it is kept only in the vault for the whole installation and never shown again. Without it the check waits and blocks nothing.
demo.missing: No demo key yet: the check is waiting for it.
demo.warn: The key goes into the vault only. The next check uses it.
demo.done: Saved. The next check uses it.
demo.removeWarn: The key is switched off (kept in the vault history). The check goes back to waiting.
demo.removed: Removed. The check is waiting for a key again.
